_comment: Canonical mobile case list. Mirrors the 21 web Playwright cases (e2e/tests/*.spec.ts) 1:1. 'file' + 'title' MUST match the web spec's describe-file basename + test title so gen-test-report.mjs aligns the rows across all four flavors. 'flow' is the Maestro flow filename (no .yaml) run in the single-session suite; a null 'flow' with 'na' means the feature has no mobile UI and is honestly rendered 'not run'.

cases.title: sidebar lists all built-in smart lists
clicking each smart list navigates and shows its header
create a task in Inbox
edit a task title
complete a task → moves to Logbook, then reopen
delete a task → moves to Trash
When = Today puts the task in the Today list
When = Someday puts the task in the Someday list
Priority = High is set via the composer and persists on the row
set a Deadline via the detail calendar sheet
add Notes to a task and see them persist
typing a query lists only matching tasks
a non-matching query shows no results
toggling "Completed tasks" shows/hides completed tasks
create an Area (appears in the sidebar)
create a Project (appears in the sidebar and opens)
add a Heading (section) to a project
cases.na: No mobile UI: 'Add section' is a wide-layout-only affordance (isWide gate in ListScreen); not reachable on a phone.

cases.title: add a task to a project via the inline composer
move a task into a project via the detail Project field
add a Tag to a task and see the badge on its row
a saved text filter lists only matching tasks
